items.titleZh: 沃尔夫支持MotoGP对卡塔尔站异议的处理
items.summaryZh: 梅赛德斯F1领队托托·沃尔夫在F1计划于该地区办赛之前，对MotoGP处理车手对卡塔尔大奖赛异议的方式表示支持。MotoGP本周末在卢赛尔赛道办赛，22名全职车手中16人参赛，仅雅马哈厂队和Pramac卫星车队缺席。
items.originalTitle: Wolff backs MotoGP's handling of calendar dissent
items.summaryEn: Mercedes Formula 1 boss Toto Wolff has backed MotoGP's handling of rider discontent over its Qatar Grand Prix, ahead of F1's own planned races in the region. MotoGP is competing at Qatar's Lusail circuit this weekend with 16 of its 22 full-time riders in action, while only the Yamaha factory team and satellite team Pramac are absent.
detailZh: 梅赛德斯F1领队托托·沃尔夫在F1计划于该地区办赛之前，对MotoGP处理车手对卡塔尔大奖赛异议的方式表示支持。
当F1齐聚因特拉戈斯参加巴西大奖赛时，MotoGP在同一周末于卡塔尔卢赛尔赛道办赛，22名全职车手中有16人（外加两名伤替补）参赛。
此前MotoGP车手之间进行了数次秘密且非正式的投票，多数人因担心中东冲突升级而投票反对举办卡塔尔站比赛。
但最终，只有雅马哈车手——即代表厂队和卫星车队Pramac的车手——在没有替补的情况下缺席卡塔尔大奖赛。
雅马哈上周日宣布，它“未找到充分理由来改变其现有的全公司差旅限制”，因此无法派车队前往卡塔尔，这一决定遭到了MotoGP的“失望”回应，并暗示可能带来“体育层面的后果”。
该赛事系列强调，在与卡塔尔、赛道以及“独立安全顾问”协商后，它并未“收到任何足以改变当前赛事计划的信息”。
至于已在卡塔尔的车手们，有些人对赛事处理方式采取了较为和解的立场，但另一些人则保持了更为对抗的语气。
值得注意的是，七届赛事冠军马克·马奎斯在赛前新闻发布会上表示：“我更希望自己身在别处。因此，我会尽可能搭乘最晚的航班抵达，并尽可能搭乘最早的航班离开。”
F1在该地区安排了两场比赛——11月29日的卡塔尔大奖赛和12月6日的阿布扎比大奖赛。
当在英特拉格斯被问及他对这两场比赛相关情况的理解是否受到了本周末在卡塔尔举行的MotoGP赛事的影响时，沃尔夫给出了详尽的回答，支持MotoGP的处理方式，并对车手们公开分享的内容提出了质疑。
“斯特凡诺[多梅尼卡利，F1掌门人]和穆罕默德[本·苏拉耶姆，国际汽联主席]对局势说得非常清楚，F1遵循国际准则，无论是旅行限制、航空公司停飞、该地区的任何警告，还是地方政府给出的那类反馈——所以不仅是推广方，还有地方政府给出的反馈。在我看来，这就是你需要依赖的东西，”沃尔夫说。
“我完全赞同这一点。我认为，如果车手站出来，对地缘政治一无所知，但他们有听众在听，我觉得这能制造媒体价值[头条新闻]——但我会做和MotoGP管理层一样的事。”
“你想骑车，或者开车，就去。如果你不想，就别去。就这么简单。
“而且每个人都可以就此做出自己的个人决定，我尊重这一点。当然，你必须警惕接下来几天或几周内发生的事情。
“斯特凡诺（Stefano）掌握着脉搏，能够监测这一点。如果情况变得更加危险，那么他将与穆罕默德（Mohammed）一起，成为第一个保护那些本应出行的人的人。所以这就是为什么我遵循我所听到的指导。
“内部没有提出过这个问题，也没有成为话题。但同样，如果有人觉得自己出行感到不舒服，那是我一直会尊重的事情。”
也许这是一个给别人机会的契机。
“这不会改变双方的关系。我一直尊重这一点，有些人不想去某些大奖赛。目前我就是这么看的。”——瓦尔·霍鲁恩日伊
沃尔夫发表上述言论之际，一级方程式即将迎来决定2026赛季如何收官的关键一周。
一段时间以来，伊莫拉一直在准备其场地，作为中东最后几站比赛无法举行时的备选方案。
然而，现在已到了必须决定是进行最后的主要准备工作还是放弃这项工作的时刻，因为卡塔尔和阿布扎比的比赛即将举行。
据了解，F1已为自己设定了下周二（11月10日）的最后期限，以就伊莫拉赛事如何处理做出最终决定。
如果到那时F1确信中东赛事可以顺利进行，那么伊莫拉就可以被取消。
然而，这一决定意味着，如果在该日期之后中东紧张局势升级，卡塔尔和阿布扎比的比赛不得不停止，那么伊莫拉将无法再举办比赛——这意味着本赛季将在拉斯维加斯结束。
尽管中东局势仍然难以预测，F1车队依然相信在最终决定中不会冒任何“风险”。
阿斯顿·马丁车队赛道运营主管迈克·克拉克表示，尽管车队人员就正在发生的情况提出了更多疑问，但大家对F1高级管理层抱有信心。
克拉克周四在英特拉格斯表示：“今天上午我与安迪（史蒂文森，赛事总监）详细讨论了此事，我们认为，我们真的确信，F1没有冒任何不必要的风险。”
“他们了解当前局势，掌握的信息远比我们充分。我认为，如果存在严重风险，他们会采取正确的行动。”
“我认为目前他们仍在评估那一情况，而且我相信他们已经为自己设定了一些截止期限，而我们还没有越过那些期限。所以，我认为我们需要给他们时间去做这件事。但如果他们冒险，我会非常惊讶。”——乔恩·诺布尔
detailEn: Mercedes Formula 1 boss Toto Wolff has backed MotoGP's handling of its Qatar Grand Prix amid rider discontent, ahead of F1's own planned races in the region.

While F1 has gathered at Interlagos for the Brazilian Grand Prix, MotoGP is competing at Qatar's Lusail circuit on the same weekend - with 16 of the 22 full-time riders (and two injury replacements) in action.
This followed several secret and unofficial votes between the MotoGP riders, in which the majority had voted against holding a Qatar race due to fears of conflict escalation in the Middle East.
In the end, though, only the Yamaha riders - those representing the factory team and the satellite team Pramac - are absent from the Qatar GP without replacement.

Yamaha announced last Sunday that it "had not identified sufficient grounds to change its existing company-wide travel restrictions" to send its teams to Qatar, a decision that was met with "disappointment" and suggestion of "sporting consequences" from MotoGP.
The series emphasised it did not "receive any information that would warrant a change to the current plans for the event" after consultation with Qatar, the track and "independent safety advisors".
As for the riders present in Qatar, some have taken a more conciliatory stance over the handling of the event, but others have maintained a more confrontational tone.

Notably, seven-time series champion Marc Marquez said in the pre-event press conference: "I would like to be in another place. For that reason I arrive on the latest flight possible, and I will leave on the earliest flight possible."
F1 has two races scheduled in the region - November 29's Qatar GP, and December 6's Abu Dhabi GP.

And when asked at Interlagos whether his understanding of the situation with those races was being informed with MotoGP racing at Qatar this weekend, Wolff offered an extensive answer that backed MotoGP's approach and questioned what the riders have shared publicly.

"Stefano [Domenicali, F1 boss] and Mohammed [Ben Sulayem, FIA president] have been pretty clear about the situation, that Formula 1 follows what the international guidelines are, whether there's travel restrictions, airlines not flying, any warnings in the region, the kind of feedback that local governments are making - so not only the promoters, but what the local governments are making. And this is what you need to rely on, in my opinion," Wolff said.

"And I'm fully with that. I think that if riders stand up, that geopolitically know nothing about what's going on but [they] have the audience that listens, I think that is something that creates media value [headlines] - but I would have done the same that MotoGP management has done.
"You want to ride, or drive, go. If you don't want to, don't go. As simple as that.
"And everybody can take their personal decisions on that, and I respect it. Of course, you've got to be wary of what's happening in the next few days, or few weeks.

"And Stefano has the finger on the pulse to monitor that. If things were to get more dangerous, then he's going to be the first one, together with Mohammed, to protect the people that were meant to travel. And so that's why I'm following the guidance of what I'm hearing.
"Internally it hasn't been raised, hasn't been a topic. But also there, if someone feels he or she doesn't feel comfortable in travelling, then it's something that I would always respect.
"And maybe that's an opportunity to give somebody else a chance.
"It wouldn't change anything for the relationship. I've always respected that, that some people didn't want to go to certain grands prix. And that's how I see it at the moment." - Val Khorounzhiy
Wolff’s comments come ahead of a crunch week for Formula 1 when it comes to defining how the 2026 season will end.
For a while now, Imola has been getting its venue ready as a fallback option in case the final Middle Eastern races cannot happen.
However, it is now at the point where it needs to commit to the final major preparations or abandon its work because the races in Qatar and Abu Dhabi are happening.
It is understood that F1 has set itself a deadline of next Tuesday (November 10) to make a final call on what to do with the Imola event.
If by then it is satisfied that the Middle Eastern races are good to go, then Imola can be stood down.

That call means, however, that if after that date tensions escalate in the Middle East and the races in Qatar and Abu Dhabi have to be halted, then it means Imola will not be able to host any more – which means the season would finish in Las Vegas.
While the situation in the Middle East remains unpredictable, F1 teams retain faith that no "risks" will be taken in the final call.
Aston Martin chief trackside officer Mike Krack said that despite team personnel asking more questions about what was happening, there was confidence in F1’s senior management.

Speaking on Thursday at Interlagos, Krack said: “Now, I discussed it at length with Andy [Stevenson, sporting director] this morning, and we think, we are really convinced, that F1 is not taking any unnecessary risk.
“They are aware of the situation, they have much better information than we have. And I think if there is a serious risk, I think they will take the correct action.

“I think at the moment they are still evaluating that situation, and I’m sure they have set themselves some deadlines, which we have not gone over yet. So, I think we need to give them the time to do that. But I would be really surprised if they take risks.” - Jon Noble
keyPointsZh: MotoGP车手此前进行了数次秘密且非正式的投票，多数人因担心中东冲突升级而投票反对举办卡塔尔站比赛。
雅马哈上周日宣布，未找到足够理由改变公司范围内的出行限制，因此不派车队前往卡塔尔，MotoGP对此表示失望并暗示会有竞技层面的后果。
keyPointsEn: MotoGP riders held several secret and unofficial votes, in which the majority voted against holding a Qatar race due to fears of conflict escalation in the Middle East.

Yamaha announced last Sunday that it had not identified sufficient grounds to change its company-wide travel restrictions, so it did not send its teams to Qatar; MotoGP expressed disappointment and suggested there would be sporting consequences.

items.originalTitle: Why Toto Wolff sees Ferrari clash as "déjà vu" – and why escalation may be necessary
items.summaryEn: After the Mexico Grand Prix, Ferrari drivers Charles Leclerc and Lewis Hamilton clashed on the opening lap, with Hamilton saying Ferrari has "big, big problems" to solve. Toto Wolff said the situation reminds him of the escalating tensions between Hamilton and Nico Rosberg.
detailZh: 为什么托托·沃尔夫认为法拉利的冲突"似曾相识"——以及为何升级或许是必要的
查尔斯·勒克莱尔与刘易斯·汉密尔顿之间的争斗让托托·沃尔夫想起汉密尔顿与尼科·罗斯伯格之间不断升级的紧张关系。"当年你们问我的就是完全相同的问题！"
墨西哥大奖赛之后，除了基米·安东内利夺得首个世界冠军之外，另一个话题主导了F1围场的讨论：法拉利的冲突。
在罗德里格斯兄弟赛道正赛首圈的事故之后，汉密尔顿表示法拉利有"很大很大的问题"需要解决，并呼吁进行深入讨论。
在媒体日上，这位七届世界冠军补充说，那些讨论尚未进行，因为勒克莱尔在此期间成为了父亲，法拉利车队领队弗雷德里克·瓦塞尔也已飞回欧洲。
然而，后者在车队领队新闻发布会上澄清，那些讨论最终于周四晚上在圣保罗进行。
不出所料，瓦塞尔在周五的新闻发布会上面对了来自现场最多的提问，这促使沃尔夫一度拿起麦克风支持他的朋友兼同行车队领队。沃尔夫强调，他曾与汉密尔顿和罗斯伯格经历过类似的过程。
“弗雷德不需要我的任何建议，但这就像似曾相识（déjà vu）”，这位梅赛德斯车队领队说道。
“你问我完全相同的问题已经多少年了？2013年、2014年、2015年和2016年。就是这样，然后尼科就宣布退役了。四年，完全一样的情况。”
不过需要指出的是，沃尔夫当时不得不应对的紧张局面，比瓦塞尔目前面临的要严重得多。这位法拉利车队领队周五说得对，墨西哥的事件并没有导致两辆红色赛车相撞，只是让车队损失了潜在的包揽前二名完赛的机会。
“有时候，当你把两位实力强劲的车手放在那里，最优秀的那些会有棱角，他们想赢，”沃尔夫继续说道。“而这是一种始终很难应对的局面，如果这些赛车在前方竞争，也是一种处于媒体聚光灯下的局面。”
夏尔·勒克莱尔，法拉利，刘易斯·汉密尔顿，法拉利
尽管两位梅赛德斯车手最终都在为世界冠军而战，而法拉利目前并非如此，但沃尔夫仍然看到了许多相似之处。
“我仍然能理解弗雷德目前所经历的一切，而且我认为有时候需要那些真正艰难的时刻，就像最近那一次，才能把问题说清楚。”
沃尔夫的意思是，一定程度的升级有时实际上有助于让车队里的每个人都清楚地认识到需要采取行动。
“当我和尼科、刘易斯在一起的时候，一旦发生事故，大家就明白那就是底线，不会再这样继续下去。所以也许正需要升级到那个地步，因为这关乎对车队的尊重，也关乎品牌里成千上万共同努力的人。这才是他们需要牢记在心的。”
最后这一点也正是瓦塞尔在墨西哥站赛后向汉密尔顿和勒克莱尔明确指出的：他们的个人野心绝不能以牺牲车队利益或马拉内罗近2000名员工的工作为代价。
在巴塞罗那那场臭名昭著的撞车多年之后，罗斯伯格透露，沃尔夫当时对局面厌烦至极，甚至威胁要更换车手阵容，还警告说如果再次发生碰撞，两位车手都必须为（部分）损失买单。
刘易斯·汉密尔顿驾驶的梅赛德斯AMG F1 W07 Hybrid与尼科·罗斯伯格驾驶的梅赛德斯AMG F1 W07 Hybrid在比赛首圈相撞
然而，当这段轶事在圣保罗被提起时，瓦塞尔不愿透露他如今是否也采取了如此严厉的措施。
“我不确定10年前托托是否告诉过你与尼科和刘易斯讨论的确切内容，我现在也会完全一样。我们进行了讨论，但这必须保密。这也是对他们和车队的尊重。”
“但再一次强调，最重要的是信息[是明确的]。信息是，我们为一个品牌工作，我们为赞助商工作，但我想说我们可能主要是为车队的员工工作。”
detailEn: Why Toto Wolff sees Ferrari clash as "déjà vu" – and why escalation may be necessary
The battle between Charles Leclerc and Lewis Hamilton reminds Toto Wolff of the escalating tensions between Hamilton and Nico Rosberg. "You asked me exactly the same questions back then!"
Following the Mexico Grand Prix, aside from Kimi Antonelli's maiden world title, one other subject has dominated the conversation in the Formula 1 paddock: the clash at Ferrari.
After the incident on the opening lap of the race at the Autodromo Hermanos Rodriguez, Hamilton indicated that Ferrari had "big, big problems" to solve, before calling for in-depth discussions.

During the media day, the seven-time world champion added that those discussions had not yet taken place, as Leclerc had become a father in the meantime and Ferrari team principal Frederic Vasseur had also flown back to Europe.
However, the latter clarified during the team principals' press conference that those discussions had eventually taken place on Thursday evening in Sao Paulo.

Unsurprisingly, Vasseur faced by far the most questions from the floor during Friday's press conference, prompting Wolff to pick up the microphone at one point to support his friend and fellow team principal. Wolff stressed that he had gone through a similar process with Hamilton and Rosberg.
"Fred doesn't need any advice from me, but it's like a déjà vu", the Mercedes team principal said.
"You've asked me exactly the same questions for how many years? 2013, 2014, 2015 and 2016. That was it, and then Nico called it a day. Four years, exactly the same situation."

It should be noted, however, that Wolff had to deal with considerably more serious tensions than Vasseur is currently facing. The Ferrari team principal rightly pointed out on Friday that the incident in Mexico had not resulted in a collision between the two red cars, but had merely cost the team a potential one-two finish.

"Sometimes when you put two strong drivers in there, the best ones have edges and they want to win”, Wolff continued. “And that is a situation that is always very difficult to cope with, and a situation that is under the media spotlight if those cars race at the front."
Charles Leclerc, Ferrari, Lewis Hamilton, Ferrari
Although both Mercedes drivers were ultimately fighting for a world championship, which is not currently the case at Ferrari, Wolff nevertheless sees many parallels.
"I can still relate to what Fred goes through at the moment, and I think sometimes it needs the really tough ones [tough moments], like the last one, to make a point."
By this, Wolff means that a certain degree of escalation can sometimes actually help make it clear to everyone in the team that action needs to be taken.

"When I was there with Nico and Lewis, when there was an accident, it was understood that that was the limit and that it wouldn't continue like this. That's why maybe it needed to escalate to that point because it's all about respect to the team, and about the many, many thousand people at the brand that work together. That's what they need to keep in their heads."

That last point is also precisely what Vasseur made clear to Hamilton and Leclerc after the race in Mexico: their personal ambitions must never come at the expense of the team's interests or the work of almost 2,000 people in Maranello.

Years after the infamous crash in Barcelona, Rosberg revealed that Wolff had been so fed up with the situation at the time that he even threatened to change the driver line-up, and also warned that both drivers would have to pay for (part of) the damage in the event of further collisions.
Lewis Hamilton, Mercedes AMG F1 W07 Hybrid and Nico Rosberg, Mercedes AMG F1 W07 Hybrid collide on the opening lap of the race
When that anecdote was brought up in Sao Paulo, however, Vasseur was unwilling to reveal whether he had now resorted to such drastic measures himself.

"I'm not sure that 10 years ago Toto told you exactly the content of the discussion with Nico and Lewis, and I will do exactly the same now. We had a discussion, but it has to stay private. It's a matter of respect also for them and for the team.

"But once again, the most important is the message [is clear]. The message is that we are working for a brand, we are working for sponsors, but I would say we are probably mainly working for the employees of the team."

items.titleZh: 2026巴西大奖赛第二场练习赛发生情况
items.summaryZh: 安东内利在巴西大奖赛第二场练习赛中表现出色，领先于诺里斯。维斯塔潘对引擎表现不满，并在练习中因转向问题提前结束。法拉利在平衡和直线速度上似乎存在困难。
items.originalTitle: What happened in F1 2026 Brazilian GP second practice
detailZh: 基米·安东内利在最近赢得的2026年一级方程式赛车冠军后，并没有表现出任何自满的迹象，他在巴西完成了周五练习赛的统治表现。
安东内利以0.253秒的领先优势领跑FP2，领先于迈凯轮的兰多·诺里斯，诺里斯带领着一群其他赛车。
实际上，领先的梅赛德斯在圣保罗赛道与一群混乱的潜在竞争者之间的差距，反映了2026年整体的比赛走势。
诺里斯、马克斯·维斯塔潘的红牛和乔治·罗素尔的梅赛德斯仅以0.020秒的差距领先，而奥斯卡·皮亚斯蒂在第二辆迈凯轮上排名第五，落后半十分之一。
维斯塔潘再次对这个练习会期中的一些引擎行为表示不满 - 而他对红牛对如何“适应”他的稍显模糊的更新感到困惑，引发了一场有趣的无线电交流，维斯塔潘建议他应该直接和离合器说话。
不那么有趣的是，由于出现了红牛无法迅速解决的转向问题，他提前结束了练习会期，回到了维修区。
在性能方面，目前的表现异常者是法拉利，它似乎在平衡性上有所挣扎，而且（像往常一样）直线速度也成问题。
刘易斯·汉密尔顿以第六名的成绩领跑车队，领先查尔斯·勒克莱尔近三十分之一 - 当F1新秀拉法·卡马拉的哈斯赛车在进入终点直道时不小心挤了他，勒克莱尔险些发生高速碰撞。
卡马拉在结束了他作为F1车手的第一个比赛日，以第16名的成绩结束，比哈斯车队队友奥利·贝尔曼慢了半秒左右，将在赛后对此次事件进行调查。
他正准备开始一圈比赛，当他在15号弯的全力转弯处导航时，不小心挤到了正在结束一圈比赛的勒克莱尔，导致勒克莱尔被挤向了缓冲区。
勒克莱尔在颠簸的缓冲区上保持了油门，设法完成了这一圈，但在这个过程中损失了几十分之一秒，并在之后表达了他的不满。
这是勒克莱尔在本周末的首个练习圈，此前迪诺·贝加诺维奇在FP1中驾驶了他的赛车。
勒克莱尔一开始就抱怨车身平衡过于偏向后方，在练习结束前他还在询问引擎的问题。
在排名前十的位置，加布里埃尔·博特洛托在家乡的赛道上驾驶奥迪赛车排在第八位，比安东内利慢了一秒多，但领先于伊萨克·哈德贾的小红牛小红牛。
奥利·贝尔曼的哈斯赛车完成了前十名的成绩，但与他只差了半个十分之一，是弗朗哥·科拉平托的阿尔派和由阿维德·林德布拉德和利亚姆·劳森驾驶的小红牛青训车队。
唯一一位没有设置时间的车手是尼科·胡肯伯格，由于在FP1中导致弗雷迪·斯莱特在赛道上停下的故障问题无法在奥迪维修区及时解决，胡肯伯格在周五的比赛中没有完成任何一圈。
对于那些能够驾驶的人来说，几乎每个人都面临着一个反复出现的挑战：第一个弯道的锁死。
至少一半的赛车在刹车进入Senna S弯道时遇到了大问题，随着赛道下降，他们正在努力应对颠簸，这可能是周六排位赛决定性表现差异的先兆。

detailEn: Kimi Antonelli showed no signs of becoming complacent after his recently-sealed 2026 Formula 1 title win as he completed his domination of Friday practice in Brazil.
Antonelli topped FP2 with a comfortable 0.253s margin ahead of McLaren’s Lando Norris, who headed a gaggle of other cars.
In fact, the gap the lead Mercedes had over a mixed-up cast of would-be contenders at Interlagos reflected how 2026 has tended to play out overall.
Norris, Max Verstappen's Red Bull and George Russell's Mercedes were covered by just 0.020s, while Oscar Piastri was fifth in the second McLaren only half a tenth further back.

Verstappen was once again displeased with some engine behaviour in this session - and his confusion over Red Bull’s slightly vague update on how it was "adapting" to him prompted an amusing radio exchange where Verstappen suggested he should start talking to the clutch directly.
Less funny was the fact he ended the session early in the garage as a steering issue emerged that Red Bull could not quickly resolve.
In performance terms, the outlier at the moment is Ferrari, which seems to be struggling on balance but also (as usual) with straightline speed.

Lewis Hamilton led the team in sixth, nearly three tenths ahead of Charles Leclerc – who survived a high-speed near-miss when F1 debutant Rafa Camara’s Haas inadvertently squeezed him coming onto the start-finish straight.
Camara, who ended his first day as an F1 driver 16th fastest and just over half a second slower than Haas team-mate Ollie Bearman, will be investigated after the session for the incident.
He was preparing to start a lap when he squeezed Leclerc, who was finishing one, towards the run-off as they navigated the flat-out kink of Turn 15.
Leclerc kept his foot in over the bumpy run-off and managed to finish the lap, losing a couple of tenths in the process, and expressed his irritation afterwards.
These were Leclerc’s first laps of the weekend after Dino Beganovic drove his car in FP1.
Early on Leclerc complained that the balance was too far to the rear, and at the end of the session he was asking about the engine.
Towards the foot of the top 10, Gabriel Bortoleto was eighth in his Audi on home soil, just over a second off Antonelli but ahead of Isack Hadjar's Red Bull.
Ollie Bearman's Haas completed the top 10 but there was just half a tenth covering him, Franco Colapinto's Alpine and the Racing Bulls of Arvid Lindblad and Liam Lawson.

The only driver not to set a time was Nico Hulkenberg, who did not run at all after the issue that stopped Freddie Slater on track in FP1 could not be addressed by Audi in time, leaving Hulkenberg without a single lap in the car on Friday.
For those who did drive, there was a recurring challenge for almost everybody: lock-ups into the first corner.

At least half the field had a big moment under braking for the Senna S, struggling with the bumps as the track falls away, which could be a precursor to a defining performance differentiator come qualifying on Saturday.
12 Arvid Lindblad (Racing Bulls) +1.245s
15 Fernando Alonso (Aston Martin) +1.775s

items.originalTitle: F1 Brazilian GP: Kimi Antonelli fastest in tricky FP2
detailZh: F1巴西大奖赛：安东内利FP2练习赛最快
在巴西大奖赛，一级方程式新科世界冠军安东内利在周五的练习赛中领先，在多云的Interlagos赛道上表现出色。
新科世界冠军安东内利在巴西大奖赛的FP2练习赛中排名第一，领先诺里斯和维斯塔潘。
在经典的4.3公里Interlagos赛道上，安东内利在FP2练习赛的中途之前设定了最快圈速，当时车手们转向使用软胎，这位意大利人比诺里斯和维斯塔潘更快。
尽管粉丝们时不时地伸手去拿雨衣，但小雨从未持续在预测中将是这个雨天周末最晴朗的一天。但较凉爽、多云的天气条件以不同的方式影响了比赛，正如刘易斯·汉密尔顿报告的那样，他“无法将轮胎温度提上来”。汉密尔顿是几位在接近严重倾斜的1号弯时锁死前左轮的车手之一。
安东内利，上周末在墨西哥成为F1历史上最年轻的世界冠军，在崎岖的赛道上遭遇了严重的底部震动，但仍然能够在硬胎上以1分11.8秒的成绩领跑早期练习。
经过一段相对安静的时期后，车场集体揭开了倍耐力的软胎配方。拉塞尔因为更换新引擎而面临五位的发车位罚分，他以1分11.016秒的成绩脱颖而出，但在诺里斯和维斯塔潘之后被降级。
拉塞尔的梅赛德斯队友安东内利跑得更快，他的成绩低于1分11秒大关，以1分10.763秒的成绩完成。这比来自三个不同车队的三位车手快了四分之一秒，这反映了2026赛季末性能的趋同。
在升级版的麦克拉伦MCL40上，诺里斯凭借1分11.016秒的圈速获得了第二名，领先第三名的维斯塔潘0.006秒，维斯塔潘因对红牛赛车离合器的无线电投诉而引发了一些笑话。
拉塞尔和奥斯卡·皮亚斯特里紧随其后，仅落后诺里斯十分之一，完成了前五名的争夺。法拉利车队通常在周五的比赛中表现强劲，但在巴西却有一个异常低调的开局。在第一区间跑得最快后，汉密尔顿满足了第六名的成绩，队友查尔斯·勒克莱尔排在第七位，勒克莱尔对在直道上被哈斯车队新秀拉斐尔·卡马拉阻挡感到遗憾。
在深绿色的奥迪赛车中，加布里埃尔·博尔特洛托在主场获得了第八名，伊萨克·哈贾尔和哈斯车队的奥利弗·贝尔曼完成了前十名。
卡马拉最终获得了第16名，比队友慢了半秒，作为哈斯车队2027年的签约车手，他在完成作为一级方程式车手的第一个完整比赛日，取代了被解雇的埃斯特班·奥康。
奥迪车队的尼克·胡肯伯格在FP1练习中因未知问题被困在维修区，此前周五早些时候，这个问题困扰了弗雷迪·斯莱特。
detailEn: F1 Brazilian GP: Kimi Antonelli fastest in tricky FP2
At the Brazilian Grand Prix, Formula 1's new world champion Kimi Antonelli led the way in Friday practice at an overcast Interlagos
Newly-minted world champion Kimi Antonelli topped Friday's second practice session at the Brazilian GP, heading Lando Norris and Max Verstappen in Sao Paulo.

At the classic 4.3km Interlagos circuit, Antonelli set his quickest time just before the halfway mark of FP2 as drivers moved towards soft-tyre running, the Italian going faster than Lando Norris and Max Verstappen.

Despite fans intermittently reaching for their ponchos, light drops of rain never really persisted on what was predicted to be the clearest day of a rain-affected weekend. But the cooler, overcast conditions did affect the running in different ways, as Lewis Hamilton reported he "can't get the tyre temperatures up". Hamilton was one of several drivers to lock up the front-left wheel on approach to the heavily cambered Turn 1.

Antonelli, who became F1's youngest ever world champion last weekend in Mexico, suffered from heavy bottoming on the bumpy layout, but still managed to lead the early running on hard tyres with a 1m11.8 lap.

Following a quieter spell, the paddock collectively unwrapped Pirelli's soft tyre compound. Russell, who has a five-place grid penalty overhanging his weekend for taking a new engine, came to the fore with a 1m11.016s lap, before being demoted by Norris and Verstappen.

Russell's Mercedes partner Antonelli went quicker still, dipping below the 1m11 barrier with a 1m10.763s effort. That was a quarter of a second quicker than three drivers from three different teams, such is the convergence of performance towards the end of the 2026 season.

In the upgraded McLaren MCL40, which boasts a new front wing, Norris took second with a 1m11.016s lap, which was 0.006s ahead of third-placed Verstappen, who caused some hilarity with his radio complaints about his Red Bull's clutch.

Russell and Oscar Piastri all followed within a tenth of Norris to complete the top five. Ferrari, often strong out of the gates on Friday, had an unusually muted start in Brazil. After going quickest in the first sector, Hamilton settled for sixth with team-mate Charles Leclerc in seventh, Leclerc rueing being impeded on the straight by Haas debutant Rafael Camara.
Aboard a dark green Audi, Gabriel Bortoleto was eighth on home soil, with Isack Hadjar and Haas driver Oliver Bearman rounding out the top 10.
Camara eventually took 16th, half a second off his team-mate, as Haas' 2027 signing completed his first full day as a grand prix driver replacing the ousted Esteban Ocon.
Audi's Nico Hulkenberg remained stuck in the garage after undisclosed issues plaguing FP1 stand-in Freddie Slater earlier on Friday.
keyPointsZh: 他在Interlagos赛道上创造了最快圈速
keyPointsEn: He set the fastest lap time at Interlagos
